originalTitle: Vanadium in VRFBs reach 20% of global vanadium consumption by 2030?
title: 2030 年钒液流电池会占全球用钒量至少 20% 吗？
Will vanadium flow batteries reach 20% of global vanadium use in 2030?
rules: 至少两家独立可靠行业来源，按钒元素质量估算 2030 年 VRFB 用钒占全球消费 ≥20%；一致低于为 No，估计分歧过大或 2032-12-31 仍不可得可 N/A。

At least two independent reputable sources must place 2030 VRFB consumption at ≥20% of global contained-V use. Consistently lower means No; unavailable/conflicting estimates by 2032-12-31 may yield N/A.
interpretation: 分母为消费而非矿产量或储能装机；原题背景预测不作为本站验证数据。
The denominator is consumption, not mine production or installed storage; background projections are not verified here.

summary: 这是关键材料消费结构预测，需要两家独立行业来源。液流电池电解液测量与全球用钒份额属于不同层次的数据。
This material-consumption forecast needs two independent industry sources; electrolyte measurements and global use shares concern different levels.
checklist: 核对钒元素质量而非 V₂O₅ 总质量。
Check contained V, not total V₂O₅ mass.
区分当年消费、电解液库存与产量。
Separate annual use, electrolyte inventory and output.
核实两家独立来源及 2030 统计年。
Verify two independent sources and 2030 reference year.

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: 液流装机可能增加电解液需求，但需求并非简单等于矿山产量。浓度、能量时长、库存周转与回收都会影响材料核算，因此市场结算仍需全球消费统计与独立来源。

Flow deployment can raise electrolyte demand, but that is not mine output. Concentration, duration, inventory and recycling affect accounting, so global consumption statistics and independent sources remain necessary.
gap: 不将原题长期需求预测写成已发生的钒消费。
Do not report long-term demand projections as observed consumption.

title: 钒价态、电解液与全球消费
Vanadium states, electrolyte and global use
principle: 全钒液流负极和正极分别利用 V(II)/V(III) 与 V(IV)/V(V) 反应。储罐、电堆和泵耗决定系统能力，但行业份额需要钒元素质量统计。
All-vanadium flow uses V(II)/V(III) and V(IV)/V(V) couples. Tanks, stacks and pumping affect systems; market shares require contained-V statistics.
example: 测得电解液浓度和荷电状态可以评估单套系统；判断 2030 年用钒占比至少 20%，还须核对两家独立行业来源与全球消费分母。
Electrolyte measurements characterize a system. The 2030 20% threshold additionally requires two independent industry sources and a global consumption denominator.
